intro: This 15 day online yoga anatomy course mixes prerecorded videos and daily 1-hour live Zoom classes with teachers from Rishikesh, India. You'll learn how your body is built (anatomy) and works (physiology), giving you a fresh way to understand your muscles, bones, and organs. In live classes, ask questions, dive deeper into topics, and get tips from teachers.
